purpose: Teach: 商談/延び/挑ん/ショートカット/変われ/つなげる/折り紙/乗り継ぎ

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.en: The negotiation is set for next week.
lines.style: Clipped, efficient delivery. Each phrase lands with finality. No softening. Eyes level, brief pause between thoughts—the cadence of someone used to being listened to without repetition.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。納期、少し延びました。
lines.en: Yes. The deadline's been pushed back a little.
lines.style: Level, attentive delivery. Slight nod with the affirmation. Calm, measured pace—reporting what was done without overselling it. Professional distance maintained.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 若手、難題に挑んだ姿勢、評価したい。
lines.en: I want to acknowledge the way the younger staff took on that difficult challenge.
lines.style: Deliberate and warm. Opens with slight weight on the praise. Even pace, measured thoughtfulness—this is a compliment that costs something to give. Lands it cleanly.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。業務、ショートカットで効率化中です。
lines.en: Yes. We're streamlining operations through some new shortcuts.
lines.style: Steady, informative tone. Slight emphasis on 'streamlining'—showing readiness. No defensiveness, just factual. The cadence of someone who's done the work and is reporting it clearly.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 時代が変われば、慣行も変える。
lines.en: When the era changes, customs must change with it.
lines.style: Quiet weight and conviction. Deliberate pace, almost philosophical. Slight pause before speaking—this is advice, not just commentary. Delivered with the ease of someone who's thought about it.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。海外拠点、つなげる体制、整えました。
lines.en: Yes. We've put the framework in place to coordinate with the overseas offices.
lines.style: Clear confirmation. Steady, accomplished tone without pride. Direct eye contact level delivery. The syntax matches Hiroshi's earlier precision—clean reporting of something substantial.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: お客様へのお土産、折り紙の鶴、好評だった。
lines.en: The origami cranes we gave to the clients went over really well.
lines.style: Genuine warmth surfaces briefly. Slight softness in the tone, almost pleased. Eyes warm for a moment. Quick—not dwelling, but the pleasure is real. This is a rare moment where Hiroshi lets something human show.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 海外出張、乗り継ぎ便、急がせます。
lines.en: I'll make sure the overseas trip connections run smoothly.
lines.style: Direct, assured close. No hesitation. Brief, efficient—the tone of someone wrapping up with confidence. Slight forward lean in the delivery, readiness implied. Final word lands with quiet assurance.
